name: Piram
overview: Piram, identified as a king of the Amorites reigning over Jarmuth, is one of five kings who allied against Israel but were ultimately defeated by Joshua. According to the account, these kings fled and hid in a cave, where Joshua had them trapped and later brought out to demonstrate Israel's victory. Joshua's exhortation to his captains to be strong and courageous reflects God's promise to subdue their enemies, with the defeat of Piram serving as a clear example of God's faithfulness in granting victory to His people.
